_why: WHO MAY SEE WHICH SECRET. Before this file every agent process inherited the whole .env, so the Trust Agent could read Legal's CourtListener token and Trading's Solana RPC URL with one line of Python. Measured 2026-09-11: both readable, 40 and 98 characters. Containerising agents without fixing this would have moved the leak into a container, not closed it.
_rule: An agent sees a credential only if it is named here as an owner. Default is DENY: a key with no entry is visible to nobody, because a secret whose owner nobody wrote down is a secret nobody is accountable for.
_shared_is_a_decision: A key listed for several agents is SHARED ON PURPOSE and the reason is recorded. Sharing by accident and sharing by decision look identical at runtime; only this file can tell them apart.

COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN.why: CourtListener is Legal's live column - how courts actually rule. No other department queries dockets.

SOLANA_RPC_URL.why: THE URL IS THE CREDENTIAL - it embeds the QuickNode key, so treating it as configuration would publish it. Trading only.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.why: Only the Inference Service calls a cloud model. Agents ask for a CAPABILITY and never hold a vendor key - that is what config/model_routing.json exists for, and an agent holding this key could bypass routing entirely.

INFERENCE_MODEL.why: Not a secret. A model name.

OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE.why: Not a secret. A cache duration.
